segments.source_raw: checkbox is on, the envelope will be engaged, starting with the ‘attack’. Attack is the amount of time it takes for the base value of the assigned parameter to reach its peak value, dictated by the Amount %. Decay is the duration of time it takes to get from the peak value to the Sustain value. Sustain is the percentage inbetween the Base and Amount value, and this value will remain the same until the ADSR node is innactive.
